task: SABA-B-11a stage 2 — interactive bars ruler + scrub strip

steps: Select demo-stem-pulse, click Add (tempo 120, Snap on, 1/4)
Click the scrub strip at x = bars.x + 15.95 s x 40 px/s, y = bars.y + 4 (snaps to 16.000 = project end)
bugs.expected: 'Click = play from here' plays from the clicked point (Live 6.1/6.3) or reports the past-end status, as a click at t = 20 does
bugs.actual: Playback starts from 0.000 (playhead 0 -> 0.84 s after 880 ms), status unchanged. Cause: the existing togglePlayback rule (current >= end - EPS and no loop -> from 0), now reachable by a strip click. Predicted by A from code; C reproduced it at both viewports. Snap band: with Snap on at 1/4 (0.5 s at 120 BPM), clicks from 15.75 to 16.25 s snap to 16.000, a 0.5 s = 20 px band at the default 40 px/s, so it is not a pixel-exact edge. Severity Low: it does not change what a user must learn (the strip still means 'play from here'), no data is affected, and it only occurs at the last grid line of a project with no active loop. Code owner of a fix (no fix proposed): playFromRuler in StudioWorkspace.tsx (granted this round) or togglePlayback in ArrangementContext.tsx (frozen; round 236 holds its grant).

steps: Fresh context, /studio-lab, seed demo-stem-pulse; Follow on
Experiment A: Space to play; an unmoved click on the bars ruler lower zone (y+15) at 5 s -> Follow state
Experiment B: Space to play; a 100 px bars-ruler drag (Follow pauses: 'Follow ‖', status 'Follow paused by manual navigation...'); then an unmoved strip click (y+4) -> Follow state
bugs.expected: Live 12 manual §6.2, verbatim (local capture b-round-71/ableton-arrangement-view-20261021.txt, confirmed by WebFetch 2026-10-28): 'Follow will pause if you make an edit or scroll the view horizontally in the Arrangement, or if you click on the beat-time ruler. Follow will start again once you stop or restart playback, or click in the Arrangement or clip scrub area.' So a lower-zone (beat-time ruler) click should pause Follow, and a scrub-strip click should resume it. Otherwise list both as deviations in the task's reference table.
bugs.actual: A: Follow stays on after a lower-zone click (and after a strip click and a seconds-ruler click; HEAD's seconds ruler is the same). B: after the drag pauses Follow, a strip click keeps it paused ('false|Follow ‖'); a lower-zone click keeps it paused too. Both viewports. Task §3 says a plain beat-time ruler click is 'Not found' and has no Follow row, so both differences are unlisted. Severity Low: the user's gestures (click = play here, drag = scroll, double-click = Fit) match Live; only the Follow side state differs, and the status line says how to resume. B may escalate to Medium if it rules that Follow-resume-on-scrub is part of what a Live user expects to learn. Not measured: a strip click while stopped with Follow paused.
